profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a public company headquartered in Shanghai, trading under the ticker HSAI and registered with the SEC under CIK number 0001861737. Its website describes the company as a global leader in 3D perception and lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility. The company says it supplies mass-produced lidar sensors to automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies in over 40 countries, with applications including AEB, NOA, and L4+ autonomous driving for robotaxis and robobuses.

The company positions its lidar technology as enabling physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence. It describes its products as high-resolution, high-performance sensors that serve as the eyes of intelligent vehicles and support advanced semi-autonomous driving features. No specific product names are listed in the available data.

The available data records no litigation cases, MCP servers, or product entries for Hesai Group. Its SEC registration and public company status are reflected in the CIK and ticker information.
